name: meta-mcp-hub
description: Meta MCP orchestration hub coordinating OpenProvider, Cline, Kilo, OpenCode, Graphify, and the free external models Claude, Kimi, and Z.ai for the krishiai.live PWA.

openprovider.description: Central controller; routes intents to local agents; fans out multi-agent tasks; handles free routing to Claude/Kimi/Z.ai; runs validation + auto-fix.
openprovider.bestAssignedTask: Central controller; routes intents to agents; fans out multi-agent tasks; handles free routing to Claude/Kimi/Z.ai

cline.description: Safe read/write under src/, public/, .graphify/, meta-mcp-hub/; generates and syncs the PWA DB schema.
cline.bestAssignedTask: Safe read/write under src/, public/, .graphify/, meta-mcp-hub/; generates and syncs DB schema

kilo.description: Plans infra; emits GitHub Actions workflows (ci.yml, deploy.yml); sets up CI/CD pipelines.
kilo.bestAssignedTask: Plans infra; emits GitHub Actions workflows (ci.yml, deploy.yml); sets up CI/CD pipelines

opencode.description: Dry-run refactors; injects environment variables; ensures clean code structure.
opencode.bestAssignedTask: Dry-run refactors; injects environment variables; ensures clean code structure

graphify.description: Builds/queries/exports the .graphify knowledge graph and provides the orchestration dashboard.
graphify.bestAssignedTask: Builds/queries/exports the .graphify knowledge graph; provides orchestration dashboard

claude.description: Compliance-sensitive validation and structured reasoning for complex workflows.
claude.bestAssignedTask: Compliance-sensitive validation; structured reasoning for complex workflows

kimi.description: Polishes outputs with bilingual formatting and professional design for reports/docs.
kimi.bestAssignedTask: Polishes outputs; bilingual formatting; professional design for reports/docs

z-ai.description: Automates structured content; clones workflows; integrates with broader pipelines.
z-ai.bestAssignedTask: Automates structured content; clones workflows; integrates with broader pipelines
